name: @sportcam/backend
description: SportCam backend: Firebase (one API function, Authentication, Firestore, Storage). Runs locally on the Firebase emulators.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n fn,emu,cam -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix functions run watch" "npm run emulators" "npm run sim"
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-sportcam --only firestore,storage,auth "cd functions && npm test"
